newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moslem rebels kill 36 people in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Moslem rebels kill 36 people in Algeria.

text.p: Moslem rebels in Algeria killed 36 people overnight in a village in Meda province, 70 km (40 miles) south of Algiers, Algerian security forces said on Sunday.
The security forces, in a statement carried by the official Algerian news agency APS, said the 36 people were killed in Sidi Abdelaziz village in the province, a Moslem guerrilla stronghold.
They blamed the massacre on a "group of terrorists", the term the authorities use to describe Moslem guerrillas in Algeria.

The killing was the latest in a series of massacres, mostly in remote villages, and bombings in Algiers and surrounding towns in which more than 300 people have died in the past two-and-a-half months.
About 60,000 people have been killed in Algeria's violence since 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
